<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Track bar progress over multiple clicks on the green part
# Current bar state
seg = current_frame.segmentation

def get_bar_state(seg):
    """Get bar state: red squares, green width, gray width"""
    red_count = 0
    green_width = 0
    gray_width = 0
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if any(p[0] < 3 for p in n['boundary']):
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if n['color'] == 'R':
                red_count += 1
            elif n['color'] == 'N':  # light green
                green_width = max(cols) - min(cols) + 1
            elif n['color'] == 'G':  # dark gray
                gray_width = max(cols) - min(cols) + 1
    return red_count, green_width, gray_width

print(f"Initial bar state: red={get_bar_state(seg)[0]}, green={get_bar_state(seg)[1]}, gray={get_bar_state(seg)[2]}")

# Click on the green part of the bar multiple times
for i in range(5):
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 1, 'col': 21}], intent='solve')
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    red, green, gray = get_bar_state(seg)
    print(f"After click {i+1}: red={red}, green={green}, gray={gray}, gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
